title: Build a RAG Context Injector
description: Construct an automated prompt injection utility that formats context excerpts and user questions with strict grounding instructions.
problemStatement: Implement a Python function `build_rag_prompt(query: str, documents: list[str], max_chars: int = 1000) -> str` that concatenates retrieved documents into a context block up to `max_chars` characters, followed by the user question and instruction to answer strictly based on the context.
hints: Iterate over documents and accumulate text while len(accumulated) + len(doc) <= max_chars.
Format the return string with clear 'Context:' and 'Query:' sections.
expectedOutput: String containing the structured RAG prompt within length limits.
